description: Machine-readable specification for the preserve-vs-repair-vs-requery research trajectory. See docs/research/RESEARCH_TRAJECTORY.md (narrative) and docs/research/EXPERIMENT_ROADMAP.md (phased plan). This file is the source of truth for parameters quoted in prose in those documents; if they disagree, trust this file. Only Phase 0 (oracle_headroom gate) has executable, tested code as of this version -- action_space.requery and all model_training fields describe future, NOT-yet-implemented work.

action_space.requery_definition_status: undefined -- see roadmap doc 'Re-query extension' for six named candidate designs, none selected

target_metric.definition: M_q(action) = nDCG@10 of the ranking extracted from the graph under `action`, evaluated against qrels for query q
target_metric.methodological_note: Both preserve and repair outcomes are computable offline from the same graph for the same query -- this is supervised effect prediction / algorithm selection, NOT causal inference, at this phase. See RESEARCH_TRAJECTORY.md section 8.

three_way_classification.rule: beneficial if delta_q > epsilon; harmful if delta_q < -epsilon; else neutral
three_way_classification.epsilon_status: NOT YET FROZEN -- must be selected from epsilon_sensitivity_grid using label_sensitivity_table before any model training, and recorded with rationale in docs/research/DECISION_LOG.md

repair_descriptors_pre_decision.note: must never leak post-outcome NDCG -- checked by label_generation.assert_no_outcome_leakage

aggregator_disagreement.source: repair_selector_mining/candidate_selection.py:_ranker_disagreement (coarse); pairwise Kendall/rank-variance across baseline_ranking.py methods NOT yet wired

cross_judge_features.note: current real-data slices are single-judge; revisit if multi-judge data is used

split_rule.prohibited: random per-row split that allows the same (dataset, query_id) to appear in more than one split

baselines.learned_implemented_in: src/consistency_ranker/repair_selector_mining/selector_training.py (never run to completion in this repository as of this spec version)

gate_0_oracle_headroom.ci_method: bootstrap_mean_interval (percentile, 10000 reps) over per-query regret of the stronger fixed baseline vs. oracle
gate_0_oracle_headroom.phase0_real_run_result: no slice cleared PROCEED_TO_LABELING as of this spec version; see the report README for the honest reading

gate_3_model_selection.rule_sketch: best learned policy must beat both always_preserve and always_repair with a CI (bootstrap or Wilson, per statistical_inference.py) excluding zero on a LOCKED test split, AND survive permutation-test and random-feature-baseline negative controls
gate_3_model_selection.modeled_after: reports/policy_selection_20260726T030500Z/decision.json's Outcome F rule (oracle_corr - always_uht_corr > 0.05 AND best_gate_corr <= always_uht_corr + 0.01), adapted from an 8-policy to a 2-action space

statistics_module: src/consistency_ranker/statistical_inference.py (bootstrap_mean_interval, sign_flip_pvalue, holm_adjust, proportion_interval -- proportion_interval MUST be used for any 0/n or n/n rate; do not reintroduce a degenerate bootstrap CI for those cases)
explicitly_out_of_scope_this_version: GNN or other non-tabular model before tabular baselines are exhausted
